assessed_claim: Sampling-invariant comparison of independently sampled paths or unlabeled targets
input_contract: Equal finite ordered arrays with independently justified pointwise correspondence, units and valid extent
allowed_nuisance_group: Translation, strictly positive scale and SO(2) if authorized; O(2), reversal, closed shift and stroke pairing separately declared
independent_oracle_scope: Known transform and independent analytic trigonometric residual for fixed correspondences; no unlabeled correspondence oracle
failure_state: INVALID_INPUT for malformed/nonfinite arrays; NOT_EVALUABLE for missing correspondence, zero/tiny unsupported extent; reject claimed invariance
observable_failure_modes: S03 relative index residual 0.5030755023105185 for changed density on same straight segment; hidden mirrors/open shifts change question
eventual_use_conditions: Restrict to supplied genuine correspondence; freeze measure, positive-scale domain, discrete permissions and numerical certification
inferential_limits: Cannot infer sampling-invariant support equality, graph labels or physical shadows; target specificity not tested
next_gate: Later signed numerical/observation contract and independent synthetic certification
alternative_scoped_disposition: ADMISSIBLE_WITH_STATED_OBSERVABLES for bounded supplied-correspondence diagnostic only; target application remains conditional

observable_failure_modes: S03 resampled relative residual 1.5478336656640429e-15 is limited to frozen straight segment; unseen curvature/retracing not recovered
eventual_use_conditions: Freeze interpolation, quadrature, sample count, endpoint inclusion, weighting and approximation bounds; validate under new signed gate
inferential_limits: Not arbitrary discretization invariance or automatic unlabeled-image comparator
next_gate: Signed target semantics/rights plus sampling/solver validation
alternative_scoped_disposition: REJECTED_FOR_CLAIMED_PURPOSE if promoted to arbitrary smooth-curve or unlabeled-image invariance

allowed_nuisance_group: Planar fit separate; SO(2) primary proposal, O(2) separate; no hidden trimming

assessed_claim: Recover or validate historical physical FIRST HAND shadows
input_contract: Authenticated geometry and finite width where claimed; camera/light/receiver/material law; calibrated independent observations
allowed_nuisance_group: Only symmetries proved compatible with optics; point-projection n/SO(2) quotient not automatic for arbitrary lighting/perspective
independent_oracle_scope: Scalar orthographic centreline and planar capsule oracles exist; physical historical surface/optics oracle absent

eventual_use_conditions: New source evidence or explicit source-constrained modeling choices; independent licensed geometry/optics validation; signed candidate/control authority
